quests.title: Gliding Challenge: New Heights

dialogue.t: Hey there, {NICKNAME}, Paimon!
Let me introduce our new colleague — this is Eija, Signals Officer for the 7th Company. And this is her able assistant, Vesper.
Pleased to make your acquaintance, Honorary Knight and the Helper in White. It's an honor to meet you.
Say hello, Vesper.
Shrawrr!

dialogue.sit: I've never heard of this position...

dialogue.t: Whoa, this falcon is so well-behaved! It looks like it's wearing armor, and it's even carrying a tiny bag!
Hold on a second, Paimon's confused... What did Amber mean when she said "performance"?
Does this have something to do with Miss Eija and Vesper?
Haha, let me explain.
Master Jean probably told you we're holding a wind glider speed shooting event, am I right? That's a very simple way of explaining it...
In reality, it might be a little different from your expectations. This event is more like a "flying performance and instruction challenge."

The crux of this event isn't gliding with a wind glider, it's about sending signals from the ground to airborne units — like Vesper — so we can instruct them to perform complex maneuvers and defeat monsters — represented by targets, naturally...
It should be a novel experience — a pleasant little surprise.
Shrawrr!

dialogue.sit: So we're not gliding, we're guiding?
So we just sit at the back and send signals?

dialogue.t: That's right! This flying challenge is a technical demonstration. Our goal is to showcase the new direction we're taking to develop the Knights' reconnaissance capabilities to our colleagues.
Amber may be able to accurately detect enemy movements and make concise records while gliding... But that's not a skill that every knight can aspire to.
The goal for Vesper and me is to write a comprehensive set of instructions so that ordinary knights can coordinate with well-trained Mondstadt falcons and form a pair of "eyes in the sky."
That way, even without strong Outriders, we can gather intelligence over sustained periods and ensure steady progress when advancing.
In fact, with the innovative forward-facing weaponry that Vesper is equipped with, some of the weaker airborne monsters we encounter can be eliminated in advance.
Wow, very impressive! You sound just like an engineer!
Relax, Eija. There's no need to be so serious around these two — you're not talking to Commander Frederica.
Just think of it as playing with a new animal friend. The most important thing is to have fun!
Sorry, Amber, I'm just really eager to get underway. Vesper and I have been training hard for this demonstration.
If we can get your approval, Honorary Knight and the Helper in White, it'll mean our instructions are basically good to go — then we can polish them up a little and put them into practice!
Of course, you might encounter a few... mechanical malfunctions during the demonstration. We've been training pretty intensely and may have ended up wearing out some of the components.
Once the replacement components are all ready, we'll swap everything out. Don't worry, we'll make sure Vesper's backpack works perfectly in the field!
Shrawrr!

dialogue.sit: I'll be strict, but I won't be harsh.
Don't worry, I'm not here to nitpick.

dialogue.t: Then Paimon's gonna give it a proper go too!
Hehe, sounds like all four of you are bursting to go! Well then, have fun!

quests.description: During the special welcome ceremony, Amber and her juniors have prepared a brand-new flying and shooting challenge, waiting for people to come and experience it…
